chunks.head: turn up
chunks.note: turn up = (人/物)不期而至地出现、露面。

literal.note_cn: 此处非'转动'义,与 up 合成'出现'

chunks.ex_en: I hope he'll turn up at the party tonight.
chunks.ex_cn: 希望他今晚会来派对。

chunks.head: go off
chunks.note: go off = 枪炮爆响、炸弹爆炸或铃声突然响起。

literal.note_cn: 此处非'去'义,表'发作/爆发'

chunks.ex_en: The alarm went off at six in the morning.
chunks.ex_cn: 闹钟早上六点响了。

chunks.head: run across
chunks.note: run across sb/sth = 无意中碰见。

literal.note_cn: 此处非'跑'义,表'偶然碰上'

chunks.ex_en: I ran across an old friend at the store.
chunks.ex_cn: 我在商店偶然碰到一位老朋友。

chunks.head: stir up
chunks.note: stir up = 唤起、发动(人或情绪)。
chunks.ex_en: His speech stirred up the crowd.
chunks.ex_cn: 他的演讲激起了人群的情绪。

chunks.head: at once
chunks.note: at once = 立即;另有'同时'之义。

literal.note_cn: 此处与 at 合成'即刻'

chunks.ex_en: Come here at once!
chunks.ex_cn: 马上过来!

chunks.head: go on
chunks.note: go on = 继续下去。
chunks.ex_en: Please go on with your story.
chunks.ex_cn: 请继续讲你的故事。

chunks.head: light up
chunks.note: light up = 使明亮、照亮;也指点(烟)。
chunks.ex_en: The fireworks lit up the night sky.
chunks.ex_cn: 烟花照亮了夜空。

chunks.head: in spite of
chunks.note: in spite of = 尽管(= despite),后接名词/动名词。

literal.note_cn: 此处非'恶意'义,为固定短语无实义

chunks.ex_en: We went out in spite of the rain.
chunks.ex_cn: 尽管下雨,我们还是出门了。

chunks.head: on the whole
chunks.note: on the whole = 综合来看、总体而言。
chunks.ex_en: On the whole, the trip was a success.
chunks.ex_cn: 总的来说,这次旅行很成功。

chunks.head: part with
chunks.note: part with sth = (不情愿地)交出、放弃某物。

literal.note_cn: 此处非'部分'义,表'舍弃/放开'

chunks.ex_en: She hated to part with her old bike.
chunks.ex_cn: 她舍不得丢掉那辆旧自行车。

chunks.head: stand guard
chunks.note: stand guard = 守卫、站岗。
chunks.ex_en: Two soldiers stood guard at the gate.
chunks.ex_cn: 两名士兵在门口站岗。

chunks.head: settle with
chunks.note: settle with sb = 跟某人算账、清账。
chunks.ex_en: I'll settle with you later for breaking my window.
chunks.ex_cn: 你打碎我的窗户,回头我跟你算账。

chunks.head: take possession of
chunks.note: take possession of = 占有、占据(可指情绪笼罩)。
chunks.ex_en: A new owner took possession of the house.
chunks.ex_cn: 新主人占用了这栋房子。

chunks.head: on board
chunks.note: on board = 在船/车/飞机上。
chunks.ex_en: All the passengers are on board the plane.
chunks.ex_cn: 所有乘客都已在飞机上。

chunks.head: blurt out
chunks.note: blurt out = 未加思索地冲口说出。
chunks.ex_en: He blurted out the secret before he could stop himself.
chunks.ex_cn: 他没忍住,把秘密脱口而出。

chunks.head: fall to doing
chunks.note: fall to doing = 动手/开始做某事。

literal.note_cn: 此处非'掉落'义,表'着手/开始'

chunks.ex_en: They fell to arguing about money again.
chunks.ex_cn: 他们又开始为钱争吵起来。

chunks.head: worn out
chunks.note: worn out = (人)累垮;(物)用旧用坏。

literal.meaning_cn: wear 的过去分词,穿旧/耗尽

chunks.ex_en: After the long hike, we were completely worn out.
chunks.ex_cn: 长途徒步后,我们累坏了。

chunks.head: take charge of
chunks.note: take charge of = 接管、负责某事/某人。
chunks.ex_en: She took charge of the class while the teacher was away.
chunks.ex_cn: 老师不在时她负责管理班级。

chunks.head: lead up to
chunks.note: lead up to = 慢慢引到(某话题/事件)。
chunks.ex_en: He slowly led up to the bad news.
chunks.ex_cn: 他慢慢地把话引到那个坏消息上。

chunks.head: shut up
chunks.note: shut up = 关门歇业;口语中也指'闭嘴'。
chunks.ex_en: They shut up the shop for the holidays.
chunks.ex_cn: 他们放假期间把店关了。

chunks.head: burst into tears
chunks.note: burst into tears = 突然哭起来。
chunks.ex_en: She burst into tears when she heard the news.
chunks.ex_cn: 听到消息她突然大哭起来。

chunks.head: a good deal
chunks.gloss: 很多、大量;(加比较级)…得多
chunks.note: a good deal = 许多;a good deal + 比较级 = …得多。

literal.note_cn: 此处非'好'义,表'很多/大量'

chunks.ex_en: This book helped me a good deal.
chunks.ex_cn: 这本书帮了我很多。

chunks.head: in the course of
chunks.note: in the course of = 在…期间、进行当中。
chunks.ex_en: In the course of the meeting, several ideas came up.
chunks.ex_cn: 会议进行中提出了几个想法。

chunks.head: keep sb from doing
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式(keep the old man from getting),故 card-only。keep sb from doing = 阻止某人做某事。
chunks.ex_en: The rain kept us from going out.
chunks.ex_cn: 这场雨使我们没能出门。

chunks.head: let slip
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式(let that slip),故 card-only。let slip = 无意中泄露、说漏嘴。

literal.note_cn: 此处非'滑倒'义,表'无意说出'

chunks.ex_en: Don't let slip that we're planning a surprise.
chunks.ex_cn: 别说漏嘴我们在筹划惊喜。

chunks.head: cover up
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式(cover that up),故 card-only。cover up = 掩盖(真相/错误)。
chunks.ex_en: He tried to cover up his mistake.
chunks.ex_cn: 他试图掩盖自己的错误。

chunks.head: give sb a turn
chunks.note: 本章出处为分离式(give you that turn),故 card-only。give sb a turn = 使某人受一阵惊吓。

literal.note_cn: 此处非'转弯/轮到'义,表'一阵惊吓'

chunks.ex_en: You gave me quite a turn, sneaking up like that!
chunks.ex_cn: 你那样悄悄冒出来,把我吓了一跳!
